title: OSCAR — Orchestrated Service & Citizen AI Router
summary: OSCAR is a proof-of-concept framework for a shared council digital front door. Its own accessibility and integration benefits remain prospective.
account: Peterborough’s OSCAR is an orchestration framework intended to connect service assistants through one governed digital front door. The source describes a proof of concept with public-facing deployment planned. The separate Hey Geraldine assistant has its own case entry. Its results do not establish outcomes for OSCAR.
purpose: Connect service-specific assistants through a shared, governed digital front door.
system: OSCAR, the Orchestrated Service & Citizen AI Router, and planned OSCAR Workforce
developer: Peterborough City Council (locally designed framework; other developers not specified)

ratings.reason: Reduced duplication and integration costs are intended, with no reported OSCAR-specific result.
A joined-up service journey is intended. Existing separate assistants do not establish an achieved OSCAR benefit.

ai_role.statement: OSCAR is intended to route requests among specialist agents and apply common governance. The source identifies it as a proof of concept, so benefits from existing separate assistants cannot be treated as demonstrated OSCAR results.

evidence.citation: Local Government Association, AI case-study bank. Council or project account published by LGA. Hosting and editorial curation do not establish independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: OSCAR — Orchestrated Service & Citizen AI Router

produced_by: The framework is designed for web, WhatsApp, and voice channels and for connection to existing services.
The reported design includes centralized permissions, redaction, guardrails, and audit logging.
must_hold: The source does not establish which conditions are necessary to reproduce the reported benefit.

headline: Peterborough develops OSCAR to connect council AI services

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The deployer's report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
